articles.title: A Space Visitor From Another Star System Just Revealed Its Secret Past
articles.summary: Imagine a comet that came from a different star! 3I/ATLAS is only the third one we've ever seen. New clues show it grew up in a super-cold, quiet part of its home system, far from its star. That's very different from comets in our solar system.

articles.title: Sea Anemones Have a Totally Different Way to Fight Viruses—and It Works!
articles.summary: Scientists found a new protein in sea anemones that fights viruses by doing the opposite of what our bodies do. Instead of turning on the immune system, it puts the brakes on—but that brake is what helps them survive infections. It's a whole new playbook for battling viruses!

articles.title: Streetlights Are Making Thousands of Pill Bugs March in Creepy Circles
articles.summary: In Israel, scientists found that ordinary streetlights trap tiny pill bugs in giant spinning circles—like a never-ending merry-go-round. Over 5,000 bugs join in, and it's not a party: it's a dangerous trap that wastes their energy and makes them easy prey for predators.
